description: This file defines the LeaveDetailedModel class in a Human Resource Management system, responsible for serializing detailed leave data into an array format for API responses. It implements data normalization, utilizes traits for date/time formatting, and constructs a comprehensive data representation including leave status, type, dates, comments, and allowed actions.

classes.name: LeaveDetailedModel
classes.description: A model for serializing detailed leave information into a format suitable for API responses, implementing the Normalizable interface and utilizing traits for helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveDetailedModel with an instance of DetailedLeave.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the DetailedLeave object into a structured associative array with nested leave details, status, actions, and comments.
